title: OSHA Bench Grinder Checklist (29 CFR 1910.215)
subtitle: For inspecting bench and floor stand grinders and for every wheel change
instructions: Mark every item OK, Defect or N/A.
If an item is marked Defect, keep the machine out of use until it is corrected and record the fix.
The machine and wheel manufacturer's instructions and your site rules may add checks.

sections.title: Guard and wheel exposure
items: A safety guard is in place over the wheel, unless one of the (a)(1) exceptions applies
Spindle end, nut and flanges covered
No spindle end, nut or flange projection sticks out beyond the guard
Guard sits in line with the wheel and does not shift or rub
All guard mounting bolts present, tight and undamaged, with no weaker substitute parts
Opening is 90° or less (up to 125° only where the work needs wheel contact below the spindle centerline)
Opening starts no more than 65° above the spindle's horizontal line
Gap from wheel face to adjustable tongue or top of peripheral member is one-fourth inch or less
Tongue or peripheral member still adjusts to follow the wheel as it wears down
Opening is measured without any visor or accessory unless it is as strong as the guard

sections.title: Work rest
items: Offhand grinder has a work rest fitted and used to support the work
Rest is rigid, not bent or loose, and can be moved in to allow for wheel wear
Opening between rest and wheel measures one-eighth inch or less
Rest is securely clamped after the last adjustment
Operators confirm they adjust the rest only when the wheel is not in motion

sections.title: Flanges, blotters and fit
items: Flanges are at least one-third the wheel diameter, or meet the exception for that wheel type
Both flanges have the same diameter and equal bearing surface
No rough surfaces, burrs or sharp edges on either flange
Bearing surfaces are not worn, warped, sprung or damaged
Driving flange is tight on the spindle and runs true
Blotters sit between each flange and the wheel, unless the wheel type is exempt under (c)(6)(ii)
Blotters cover the whole flange contact area
Wheel, blotter and flange faces are flat with no dirt, chips or debris
Wheel slides onto the spindle freely, without forcing
Any bushing is no wider than the wheel and clear of the flanges

sections.title: Wheel check before mounting
items: Wheel examined closely for damage from transit or storage before it goes on
Machine spindle speed does not exceed the maximum operating speed marked on the wheel
Wheel gives a clear ring when tapped; a dead-sounding wheel is set aside and not used
Wheel is dry and free of sawdust when tapped
Tapped about 45° either side of vertical, 1 or 2 inches in from the edge, then turned 45° and tapped again

sections.title: Type 27 and 28 wheels
items: A guard sits between the wheel and the operator whenever the wheel is used
Mounts the manufacturer fixed to a wheel are not reused
Wheel is a reinforced organic bonded wheel

references: 29 CFR 1910.215: Abrasive wheel machinery (Part 1910 Subpart O, Machinery and Machine Guarding)
Source: eCFR, Title 29, text as of 2026-11-09
